rationale.org-governance: operating envelope, policy-as-code, roles, audit, accountability apparatus across regulated orgs
rationale.provenance-auditability: immutable audit log + provenance receipts preserved for human review/retention
rationale.regulatory-compliance: aligns EU AI Act Art.14, NIST RMF, ATO, audit evidence
rationale.oversight-theater: Scapegoat-as-a-Service: HITL as rubber-stamp liability transfer under throughput
rationale.hitl-workflow: envelope, circuit breakers, approval gates, bounded delegation tiered by consequence
rationale.oversight-explanation: evidence record gives reviewer verifiable artifacts to judge, not summaries
rationale.general-ai: object = agentic AI actions (payments/clinical/records); code explicitly out of scope
rationale.risk-overreliance: focal analysis + mitigation for rubber-stamping/skill-erosion over-reliance
rationale.design-only: architecture + evidence-record spec, reference implementation deferred, never run
